messages:
deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECK FAILED: env parity mismatch for release 2026-04-02T09:00Z.
deploybot: STAGING: INFER_CACHE_TTL=3600, KVCACHE_ENABLED=true
deploybot: PROD:    INFER_CACHE_TTL= (missing), KVCACHE_ENABLED=true
deploybot: Canary 8% (5/64). Promotion blocked.
jess_r: noticed this in local repro yesterday; missing TTL causes unbounded cache growth on some tenants. we should not promote.
eng_sre: agree. risk = memory growth -> OOM on inference pods under bursty write patterns.
release-eng: change window is open but ops requested no direct keystore writes unless triaged.
jess_r: options: A) backfill INFER_CACHE_TTL in prod keystore now B) patch rollout to include "cache_ttl_override=3600" for canary only C) rollback canary.
eng_sre: minimal blast radius is B. we can patch canary rollout config without touching prod keystore.
tom_y: command to patch: `/rollout patch --id=2823456789 --set cache_ttl_override=3600 --scope=canary`
release-eng: approved. executing patch now.
deploybot: ROLLOUT UPDATE: canary pool updated with cache_ttl_override=3600. Canary remains at 8%. Promotion paused.
jess_r: monitoring: added alert: kvcache-mem-growth > 200MB in 5m for canary tenants. also increased log level for cache-evict.
eng_sre: observed no mem spike after patched requests. synthetic workload ramped x5 for 10m.
release-eng: decision: proceed to hold promotion and create follow-up to backfill prod keystore in maintenance window. created ticket REL-4980.
tom_y: note for release notes: "Canary pinned with temporary cache TTL override; prod keystore backfill scheduled."
jess_r: will open PR to harden rotation job to assert TTL present on prod before rotation.
release-eng: summary: blocked by missing INFER_CACHE_TTL; applied canary-only patch to override TTL; promotion paused; follow-up REL-4980 created; rollback command available `/release rollback 2823456789 --reason=cache-ttl-parity`
eng_sre: leaving monitoring for 45m. will escalate if mem > threshold.
release-eng: closing thread once REL-4980 triaged. :white_check_mark:
